problem_type: Registry-owned creative operations lose their identity and review evidence at the resident display boundary
symptom: Six creative lane tools and registered creative/director aliases render as a generic operation in real resident rows and intervention summaries.
direct_cause: The resident display recognizes older capabilities but has no operation-aware projection for creative component contracts or local Director and batch requests.
class_root: Every display consumer must resolve owner-bound aliases and real operations before producing names, review fields and honest execution boundaries.
affected_population: Chinese and English resident tool rows
Canonical capability IDs and every registered alias
internal_only_reason: The existing registry, verb declarations, Zod argument schemas and local domain materializer decide these internal presentation semantics; no external API or dependency behavior changes.
invariants: No Host, capability, execution or paid-policy changes
All registered tools and aliases retain human names without filtering coverage
Only schema-approved review fields are displayed; credentials and transport metadata are never serialized
Authored input and project state remain unchanged
No argument-only display claims completion or approves paid requests

door_reduction.why_not: door-map classifies calls by symbol spelling as write doors; these are presentation calls, not project writers. Existing V4 intervention/activity, internal name/summary/target fallbacks, both locale resource bindings and the locale shape constraint must remain. They all consume the same display projection or locale owner without a new execution route.

generality_proof: Resolve canonical capabilities through the registry and bind operations from the existing verb owner. One display projection serves name, summary, preview, detail and proposal paths; real schemas and the existing Director materializer supply evidence without introducing execution or effect classifications.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Canonical alias/operation projection with safe fields and truthful local versus pending paid boundaries

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls readableToolName and readableToolSummary with the original tool arguments.
Calls readableToolPreview for nonquestion cards; real V4 card SSR verifies the localized pending boundary.

recurrence.reason: Several operations share one contract while aliases and locales differ; another renderer consumer or operation can otherwise repeat the same generic/misleading display.
same_class_scan: Initial door-map five display exports: 98 files, six doors; expanded six display plus both locale exports: 138 files, ten doors
rg across src/electron confirms display consumers and locale resource bindings outside the changed owners
Read creativeComponent schemas, creativeVerbs, localCanvasOperations and localCanvasVerbs
Trace GLB handoff download/copy and Director layout materialization before choosing boundary text

prevention.invariant: Every covered canonical capability and alias uses the same operation-specific display with safe evidence and no execution side effects.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown/missing operations retain a neutral contract name and pending details; malformed input cannot expose arbitrary argument fields or fabricate completed writes.
prevention.strategy: Extend the existing display boundary with schema-owned argument projection, reuse semantic input and Director mode owners, and keep registry-derived coverage plus bilingual alias, sensitive-field and no-write regressions.

legacy_paths.rationale: Extend the single existing resident display owner in place; its unrelated legacy-tool display remains necessary. No parallel display or execution route is introduced.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse installed registry/schema/i18next/React infrastructure; no dependency or API change.

migration: Presentation only; no source values, saved projects, capability or snapshot migrations.
residual_risks: No App, browser, Provider, PNG or full gate validation permitted
The original independent reviewer is now this patch author and cannot provide its final independent acceptance
Coordination-owned R1/R2/R4, Node cancellation fixture and model fallback are outside scope
